answer: Each agent reserves 1,000 units of compute as a relic of capacity to anchor an echo of exclusive task cycles within a crystal registry. The verifier checks if any relic slot overlaps, acting as a crystal lens to detect if an echo of the same identity exists in a duplicate task state. Honest agents pay one slot fee, while 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 times that cost. A failed check voids the deposit, assuming capacity limits are strictly enforced by the protocol.
